notes:
Account snapshot: enterprise legal discovery platform used by large law firms and corporate compliance teams. Primary product: full-text ingestion + tagging + case foldering. Current search is BM25 + shallow TF-IDF; looking to add dense embeddings + neural reranker for better recall/precision on sensitive docs.

Scale & traffic: ~120M indexed documents (scanned filings, contracts, redacted exhibits). Expected query volume: 300k–600k QPS/day (peak patterns during discovery windows). Typical query pattern: short user query -> sparse retrieval -> dense embed top1k -> cheap dot-prod filter -> cross-encoder rerank top50.

Perf targets & cost constraints: latency SLO for interactive reviewers: median end-to-end <250ms, p95 <600ms for single-case searches; reranker per-document latency budget <8ms. Cost goal: <$0.02 per user-search (all stages combined) or justify with quality delta.

Security/compliance: Must support VPC deployment or on-prem appliance. Immutable audit logs for 7+ years; ability to export full audit trail for e-discovery/legal hold. KMS/HSM integration mandatory. Data residency: primary US-only tenancy with EU fallback for certain clients. Retention policy enforcement and deletion workflows required.

Technical preferences: prefer multi-stage retrieval to minimize reranker runs. Want recommendations on quantization/CPU offload for bulk rerank and guidance on batching to hit latency/cost targets. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching profiles.

POC notes: Hosted POC showed recall lift ~18% on labeled set but cost and token leakage concerns flagged. Next POC will be VPC-hosted with encrypted storage, no logs leaving tenant; need SE help to size GPU pool for cross-encoder reranker at 50qps sustained with burst to 400qps.

Customer quotes (paraphrased): 'We need chain-of-custody-quality logs — can't have ephemeral traces that can't be audited.'
